'''2012 Worlds Day 2 Emil Wallin DS Spice Mine Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Emil Wallin]] at [[2012 World Championship]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Emil Wallin]]
* '''Event:''' [[2012 World Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Spice Mine Operations (V) (Virtual Block 6)|Spice Mine Operations (V)]]
* '''Username:''' Darth_Link
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
